title: Keyword Trends Data: raw Google Trends 0-100 series and related queries
description: Weekly Google Trends 0-100 index for the query “keyword trends” (US, today 12-m, 53 weeks) plus 87 related-query rows for four seeds, with three reproducible Python scripts. The index is a share of the busiest week in the chosen window, not search volume. Full explanation, download links and worked examples: https://keywordtrendsguide.com/data/
